title: Wipe the bathroom sink
materials: kid-safe cleaner if a grown-up says so

steps.text: Ask a grown-up which cleaner to use.
steps.tip: Water and a cloth is enough if they say so.

steps.text: Move soap and toothbrush cups to the side.
steps.tip: Put them on a towel so they do not roll.

steps.text: Wipe the sink, faucet, and handles.
steps.tip: Finish by wiping the counter around the sink.
Toothbrushes stand up, soap by the faucet.

done_when: Sink looks clean and not soapy
parent_notes: grown_up_required: no bleach, no toilet chemicals, no mixing products. Grown-up hands the cloth.
